references.scene: Guild dormitory, wide ordinary gameplay view
visible_findings: At least three separate red-covered wooden bed forms: one cropped at the left edge and two against the rear wall.
Red plaster-like upper wall panels between heavy timber uprights; continuous dark carved lower wall panels.
Tall narrow pointed blue windows, diagonal-pattern stone floor and several separate rectangular patterned rugs.
Stone pointed doorway at left and part of a suspended circular fixture at the top edge.
limits: A useful wide non-burning room view, but not the entire room: the exact total bed count, hidden furniture and complete floor/roof plan remain unknown.
Purple NPC selection/social glow and unknown display settings prevent calibrated neutral-light or color claims.
Guild minimap, visible beds and original wall details support room identity; the image does not establish the present generator's two-floor dormitory layout.
